data.one_liner: Manage CPU-intensive calculations across isolates with reusable workers and cancellation.
data.what_it_does: Worker Manager is a library that helps efficiently manage CPU-intensive tasks across Dart isolates. It offers reusable isolates, task cancellation, gentle cancellation, and inter-isolate communication via ports to prevent app freezes.
use_when: You need to run heavy CPU-bound computations without freezing the UI
You want to reuse isolates instead of spawning a new one via compute every time
You need to cancel running background tasks or communicate via ports
avoid_when: You only need simple asynchronous I/O operations
You are running very short tasks where isolate startup overhead outweighs benefits
strengths: Task cancellation and gentle cancellation support
weaknesses: Functions passed must be static methods, globally defined functions, or lambdas
On web before isolate support, fallback executes similarly to compute method
